definitions: To use the same methods or tactics as an opponent, especially when those methods are aggressive or unethical.
To respond to an attack or challenge by using a similar form of attack or challenge.
examples: When they started spreading rumors, we decided to fight fire with fire and expose their own secrets.
The company chose to fight fire with fire by launching a competing product with similar features.
He believes the only way to deal with a bully is to fight fire with fire.
synonyms: give someone a taste of their own medicine
